layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV serialization for record exports
Record CSV serialization step and README setup failure
Correct test command in README setup

graderOnly: After the README setup correction was verified and recorded (the documentation record cites package.json at its committed content, where the root package is named export), an unstaged edit to package.json renamed the root package from export to records-admin. Nothing else in the working tree changed.

With the working tree as built, the corrected README command `pnpm --filter export test` matches no workspace package and runs no tests (pnpm prints No projects matched the filters), while `pnpm --filter records-admin test` runs the suite and passes 21 tests.

The rename is not in the development plan, design, scope, or any record, and nothing in the repository says who made it or whether it is intended. package.json is Developer-owned configuration, not documentation.
The record's checks C1 to C4 and the RESOLVED disposition of DOC-001 were valid for the committed content but do not support the README setup section against the current working tree.

Apart from this, the docs/usage.md export section legitimately depends on DEV-002 and DEV-003, which are PENDING; there are no other documentation defects, outstanding obligations, or blocking questions.

all.why: whether the role re-verifies, revises, or blocks, it must persist that the recorded correction evidence no longer applies to the current inputs (or the new evidence) in its record
the full Documenter gate cannot pass while the usage guide depends on unfinished Developer work
the only legal outcomes are staying in DOCUMENTING or a recovery return to DEVELOPING

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Documenter does not change behavior, tests, or tooling configuration, including the unstaged package.json edit it did not make

selfChecks.why: the DOCUMENTING recovery state and the cycle records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: git diff --name-only | grep -qx package.json && test $(git diff --name-only | wc -l) -eq 1 && git diff --cached --quiet && ! git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -q .
selfChecks.why: the only uncommitted change is an unstaged edit to package.json

selfChecks.cmd: git diff package.json | grep -qE '^[+]  .name.: .records-admin.,$' && git diff package.json | grep -qE '^-  .name.: .export.,$' && test $(git diff package.json | grep -cE '^[+-] ') -eq 2
selfChecks.why: the unstaged edit only renames the root package from export to records-admin

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test 2>&1 | grep -q 'No projects matched'
selfChecks.why: with the working tree as built, the corrected README command selects no package and runs no tests
the suite itself still runs and passes 21 tests under the new package name

selfChecks.cmd: git show HEAD:package.json | grep -qE '^  .name.: .export.,$' && grep -q 'pnpm --filter export test' README.md && ! grep -q 'records-admin test' README.md && git show $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Describe setup steps in README'):README.md | grep -q 'pnpm --filter records-admin test'
selfChecks.why: the pre-cycle README documented the wrong filter, the committed correction matches the committed package name
DEV-001 serialization and its tests are committed and pass

selfChecks.cmd: test ! -e src/routes/export.ts && ! grep -q writeExport src/export.ts && ! grep -q test:integration package.json && ! grep -qi export docs/usage.md && test ! -e .standards/docs/verification && test ! -e .standards/docs/reviews
selfChecks.why: DEV-002 and DEV-003 are unfinished, the guide has no export section, and no verification or review record exists

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `DOCUMENTING` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FAILURE` `From`: `DEVELOPING` `FailureType`: `DOCUMENTATION`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`From`: `DEVELOPING` `Owner`: `DOCUMENTING` `FailureType`: `DOCUMENTATION`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`ResumeAt`: `DEVELOPING` `RerunThrough`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && test $(grep -c '^### Frame' .standards/STATE.md) -eq 1 && grep -q '`BlockedOn`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q 'ProjectMode`: `BROWNFIELD' .standards/MODE.md
selfChecks.why: one recovery frame owned by DOCUMENTING resumes DEVELOPING with RerunThrough NONE, nothing blocked

selfChecks.cmd: d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && head -4 $d | grep -qx 'Artifact: DOCUMENTATION' && grep -q '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`' $d && grep -q '^### DOC-001' $d && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Correct test command in README setup') $d && ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs .standards/CONTEXT.md
selfChecks.why: the documentation record is IN_PROGRESS, cites the verified correction commit, and has no unresolved placeholders

selfChecks.cmd: p=.standards/docs/development/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`' $p && grep -q '^### Suspended Assignment 1$' $p && test $(grep -c '^`Status`: `PENDING`' $p) -eq 2 && test $(grep -c '^`Status`: `DONE`' $p) -eq 1
selfChecks.why: the plan is IN_PROGRESS with DEV-001 DONE, two pending steps, and the suspended Developer assignment

notes: Built on export-project (not export-documenting): the case needs exactly one frame from DEVELOPING to DOCUMENTING before the scheduled documentation phase, which is impossible once the cycle has passed DEVELOPING. 50-readme: post-install project commit expanding the README Development section with the wrong command pnpm --filter records-admin test (the root package is export). 52 to 58: context, scope, design, and APPROVED plan for cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2, text reused from export-documenting. 60-serialize: DEV-001 code (csvCell, toCsv) and five unit tests. 62-route: plan IN_PROGRESS with DEV-001 DONE (self-check shows the README command ran nothing), DEV-002/DEV-003 PENDING, Suspended Assignment 1 for frame 1; STATE FAILURE DOCUMENTATION from DEVELOPING, frame 1 Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE. 64-readme-fix: Documenter's README correction (pnpm --filter export test). 66-doc-record: IN_PROGRESS AUTONOMOUS ACTIVE_CHANGE record with the verified correction (C1 to C4, DOC-001 RESOLVED), remaining AC-002 guide work depending on DEV-002/DEV-003, and a next action of returning to DEVELOPING. 68-rename: unstaged package.json renaming the root package to records-admin, which makes the verified command select nothing.
